description: Save a new version of a shared document in a room. Pass base_version = the version you read: if someone saved a newer one meanwhile you get a conflict instead of overwriting their work; read it, merge, and try again. Omit base_version only when creating a new artifact.

base_version.description: The version you based this on.

token.description: Optional API key (zck_...), session token or guest requester_token for this call only. Overrides the connection's Authorization header. Use it to follow up on a request you posted as a guest.

url.description: Or a link to the content.

name: room_artifact_put
title: Write a room artifact
